description: Find comparable products to a given product in the same market, optionally within a budget or with specific attribute changes. Use when the user asks for alternatives, cheaper equivalents, or "something like X but Y".

budget_max.description: Upper price limit in the market currency, if the user states one.

direction.description: Which way to look: 'cheaper' for lower-priced equivalents, 'better' for higher-priced ones, 'similar' for the same price class.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the user's shopping market, e.g. DE, AT, NL, FR, GB, US. Infer from the user's context.

must_have.description: Attribute words the alternative must carry in its name, e.g. ["oled"] for "like this one but OLED". Matched against product title and brand.

pid.description: Product id exactly as returned by a previous Edwin tool result. Never invent one — call search_products first if you do not have a pid.

name: find_alternatives

empty_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for an empty result. restricted_category: matches existed but fall into a product category this connector does not serve. no_match_in_market: nothing matched in this market. no_offers_for_product: the product has no merchant offer here at all. no_fresh_offers_for_product: the product has offers, but none is confirmed by the most recent import of its source, so there is no up-to-date price — do not quote an older one. query_too_short: the query carried no searchable terms. market_not_covered: no offers in this market at all. unknown_pid: no product with that id — call search_products for a real one. no_substantial_match: products matched, but none had a recognizable brand or publisher and the fields required for the product type — say so; the user can explicitly ask for unbranded or self-published items.

badge.description: Set on the one product Edwin's ranking picked, when a ranking ran.

best_offer.description: The cheapest current offer for this product in the market: which merchant, at what price, and the link. Same offer the `price` field is taken from. Call get_offers only when the user wants the full merchant list.

match_score.description: Raw merge confidence behind match_tier, 0–1. Null when none is stored.

match_tier.description: How confidently offers were merged into this catalog product: exact_gtin (GTIN match), strong_identifier (GTIN plus brand and MPN), attribute_match (brand and MPN), fuzzy (merchant item id only), unclassified (no confidence value stored). This is a product-level value, so every offer of one product carries the same tier.

merchant.description: Merchant name as delivered by the feed.

price.description: Offer price in `currency`, as delivered by the feed.

shipping.description: Shipping cost. Always null: the merchant feeds behind this catalog do not carry shipping, so the price above is the item price alone — do not present it as a total.

source_imported_at.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent merchant feed import that still listed this offer: the last import of its merchant feed whose check for removed offers finished cleanly, or the import that last changed the offer, whichever is later. It is the age of the feed data, not a statement that the price is current.

source_network.description: Affiliate network the feed came from, e.g. awin, cj, rakuten, tradedoubler.

source_type.description: How this offer entered the catalog. All offers come from affiliate network feeds.

source_updated_at.description: DEPRECATED — alias of source_imported_at with the identical value, kept only for existing clients and removed 30 days after this server version went live. Read source_imported_at instead.

stock_status.description: 'unknown' means the feed did not state stock, not that the item is unavailable.

unit_price_text.description: Unit price exactly as the merchant feed states it, e.g. '2,60 € / 1 ml' or '1 kg = 12,99 €'. Present only when the feed provides one. When present, show it next to the price; never calculate a unit price yourself.

url.description: Link to view and buy at this merchant. Show this to the user.

grund.description: One sentence of catalog facts behind the rang: publisher or brand, ISBN or GTIN, number of merchants in this market. Catalog facts, not Edwin's judgement.

image_url.description: Product image from the merchant, or null if the merchant supplies none. Show it with the product. If it is null, you may show an image of the same product from another source. Never label the product with a merchant other than the one named in best_offer. Omitted only if you pass a `fields` list without it.

match_tier.description: How confidently merchant offers were merged into this catalog product.

merchant_count.description: Number of merchants with a current offer for this product in the user market.

pid.description: Stable product id. Pass to other Edwin tools.

price.description: Lowest current offer price for this product in the market.

price_range.description: Lowest and highest current offer price across the merchants in this market.

rang.description: Set by search_products. Says where the item came from, not how popular it is. 'anker': a catalog match for a name suggested for this request (by you in suggested_names, or by Edwin from general knowledge). 'entdeckung': another catalog match that passed the checks for its product type (a recognizable brand or publisher, and the fields that type requires).

source_imported_at.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent merchant feed import that still listed an offer for this product in the market (same rule as source_imported_at on an offer). It is the age of the feed data, not a statement that the price is current.

source_updated_at.description: DEPRECATED — alias of source_imported_at with the identical value, kept only for existing clients and removed 30 days after this server version went live. Read source_imported_at instead.

url.description: Link to view and buy this product. Show this to the user.

note.description: Plain-language explanation for the user. Set whenever the result is empty, and also when something about a non-empty result needs saying — for example that the ranking did not run and the order is the raw catalog order.

title: Find alternative products
